text:
marta: Heads-up — Orbitix customer hero profile: recording locked for Thu 10am PT (Zoom link in doc). Need final quote for opening paragraph + legal sign-off on customer name/metrics. Who can take?

liam: I can draft quote; can someone share the usage number to cite (Q4 latency improvement)?

raj: We can confirm: Orbitix saw ~43% latency reduction on our dedicated plan. I'll double-check with their engineer — expect confirmation by EOD Tue.

marta: Perfect. @liam can you drop a 1-liner quote by EOD? Also we need Orbitix marketing contact to sign asset release. @olivia any chance to queue the release form?

olivia: Yep — I'll send the release form now and set a reminder for Thu AM. I'll cc legal.

sara: On legal — quick note: please avoid disclosing revenue figures. Usage and percentage improvements ok if corroborated. If they want to change the quote, we'll need a signed release with redlines.

liam: Draft quote: `Redwood's dedicated runtime cut our end-to-end inference latency by over 40%, letting us double query throughput without infra changes.` Thoughts?

raj: That's close. Can we change 'over 40%' -> '~43%' per the metrics? Customer prefers exact if we have the number.

marta: Agree. Also add a short line about reliability — Orbitix is sensitive to SLOs.

liam: Updated: `Redwood's dedicated runtime reduced our end-to-end inference latency by ~43%, doubling query throughput and improving operational reliability.`

sara: Approve pending release form. One legal ask: add this consent blurb into the release: 'Customer consents to use of name, logo, and anonymized performance metrics in Redwood marketing materials.' I'll paste legal-approved text in the form.

olivia: Form sent to orbitix@orbitix.io. I'll notify here once signed.

raj: :thumbsup: I'll ping their engineer to confirm the metric and reply with the signed form if I get it.

marta: Thanks team. Once signed, @liam please finalize the hero copy and send to me for scheduling. Plan is to publish blog + short LinkedIn post + one-page battlecard. Also small webinar invite to leads who interacted with Orbitix case study — @olivia can you add that routing rule: leads with 'Orbitix' pageview -> SDR queue 'Sector-North'?

olivia: On it. I'll add a tracking param ?case=orbitix and route via the webhook to Sector-North SDR. Will confirm webhook id.

deploy-bot: Scheduled draft in content repo at /drafts/orbitix-hero.md (private) — awaiting 'approved' label.

marta: :party-parrot: good progress. Last item — does anyone own a quick benchmark graph? Need latency vs baseline plot (png).

raj: I can export a chart from our dashboards by Wed morning and drop into the drive.

liam: If we need copy for the webinar landing, I'll work with @marta. ETA Thu morning once legal ok.

olivia: Signed release received from Orbitix — attached in Drive: /releases/orbitix-release-signed.pdf. Marking as cleared.

marta: :tada: Awesome. Marking thread as actionable checklist: 1) final copy (liam), 2) benchmark graphic (raj), 3) publish release (olivia), 4) legal verbiage included (sara), 5) routing rule for leads (olivia). I'll schedule blog for Fri 9am PT if everything green.

liam: :thumbsup: I'll drop final copy here by 9am Thu.
